Name: Sheba, Son of Joktan
Summary: Sheba was a son of Joktan and a descendant of Eber, in the line of Shem.
KeyStory: Sheba is named among Joktan's thirteen sons, whose families spread toward the east.
RelatedPeople: Joktan; Ophir; Havilah, Son of Joktan
LifeLesson: God's promise to fill the earth moved forward through families like this one.
